lines.text: The chief priests and scribes feared the people, so Judas agreed with them to betray Jesus for money.
On the day the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed, Jesus sent Peter and Andrew to prepare the Passover.
Jesus told them to follow a man carrying a jug of water to a house with a large upper room.
Jesus told His apostles He had eagerly desired to eat this Passover with them before the Sabbath.
Jesus gave them bread as His body and a cup as the new covenant, and said His betrayer was at the table.
